title: Nonzero ideal sheaf iff all nonempty affine sections are nonzero
statement: Let (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsIntegral X] and (J : X.IdealSheafData). Then J ≠ ⊥ ↔ ∀ U : X.affineOpens, Nonempty U.1 → J.ideal U ≠ ⊥.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, proof of Lemma 01YL

proof.text: The closed support contains the generic point iff it is all of X (genericPoint_closure); support_eq_top_iff on a reduced scheme identifies this with J = bottom. On every nonempty affine U, mem_support_iff_of_mem and fromSpec_preimage_zeroLocus identify generic-point membership with the section ideal lying in the zero prime (primeIdealOf_genericPoint and genericPoint_eq_bot_of_affine). Negate, and choose one affine neighborhood for the converse. All lemmas are proved in Mathlib.

theorem integral_ideal_nonzero_iff_affine_sections (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsIntegral X]
    (J : X.IdealSheafData) :
    J ≠ ⊥ ↔ ∀ U : X.affineOpens, Nonempty U.1 → J.ideal U ≠ ⊥
